rules.sql: SELECT record_id, COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period GROUP BY record_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: record_id is a deterministic SHA-256 hash of the grain (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, growth_type). Duplicates indicate a computation or dedup guard bug.

rules.description: Every row has valid growth_type (yoy_change, yoy_pct_change, cagr_5yr)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_type NOT IN ('yoy_change', 'yoy_pct_change', 'cagr_5yr')
rules.rationale: Only 3 defined growth types exist. Unknown growth_types indicate a config or build bug.

rules.description: Every row has valid cik (exists in consumable.company_financials)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period pp WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumable.company_financials cf WHERE cf.cik = pp.cik)
rules.rationale: All growth metric CIKs must exist in the source company_financials table. Orphan CIKs indicate a build bug.

rules.description: No null growth_value (every row has a computed value)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_value IS NULL
rules.rationale: Every growth row must have a computed value. Null growth_value indicates the build pipeline created a row without computing the metric.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_type IN ('yoy_change', 'yoy_pct_change') AND prior_val IS NULL
rules.rationale: YoY growth requires a prior year value. Null prior_val on YoY rows indicates the build pipeline failed to populate the comparison value.

rules.description: CAGR rows have non-null base_val and base_fiscal_year
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_type = 'cagr_5yr' AND (base_val IS NULL OR base_fiscal_year IS NULL)
rules.rationale: CAGR requires a base year value and the base fiscal year reference. Nulls on CAGR rows indicate the build pipeline failed to populate comparison values.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_type = 'cagr_5yr' AND base_fiscal_year != fiscal_year - 5
rules.rationale: 5-year CAGR always looks back exactly 5 years. Any other gap indicates a build bug.

rules.description: YoY pct change: prior_val is never 0 (division by zero guard)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_type = 'yoy_pct_change' AND prior_val = 0
rules.rationale: The build pipeline skips yoy_pct_change when prior_val is 0. Any row with prior_val=0 indicates the guard failed. EDA found 24 zero values across 6 business terms.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_type = 'cagr_5yr' AND base_val <= 0
rules.rationale: CAGR formula (current/base)^(1/5) - 1 requires base > 0. Negative or zero base makes the fractional exponent undefined or division by zero.

rules.description: All 3 growth types represented in the table
rules.rationale: The table must contain data for all 3 defined growth types. EDA confirms each type has sufficient source data.

rules.description: All 25 business terms represented in YoY rows
rules.sql: SELECT 25 - COUNT(DISTINCT business_term_id) FROM consumable.period_over_period WHERE growth_type = 'yoy_change'
rules.rationale: All 25 business terms from company_financials should have YoY growth data. EDA confirms every business term has multi-year data for all 20 companies.

rules.description: companies_reporting is accurate (matches actual distinct company count per growth_type per business_term_id per fiscal_period)
rules.sql: SELECT pp.growth_type, pp.business_term_id, pp.fiscal_period, pp.companies_reporting, COUNT(DISTINCT pp.cik) AS actual_count FROM consumable.period_over_period pp GROUP BY pp.growth_type, pp.business_term_id, pp.fiscal_period, pp.companies_reporting HAVING pp.companies_reporting != COUNT(DISTINCT pp.cik)
rules.rationale: companies_reporting is a denormalized aggregate. It must match the actual count of distinct CIKs for each (growth_type, business_term_id, fiscal_period) combination.
